search: Search name, CIN or employee number…
empty_employees_body: Add your first employee to start tracking daily pay, advances, and attendance.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
confirm_delete: Delete this record? This cannot be undone.
delete_employee_body: Employees with payroll history can be archived. Only employees without advances, absences, or statements can be permanently deleted.
login_body: A clear view of your people. A simpler way to pay.
setup_body: Create your administrator account to get started.
login_description: Bring your team, daily wages, and payments together in one thoughtful workspace.
secure_workspace: A private workspace for your team
overview_body: A little clarity for your working day.
team_body: Manage your team and keep every detail in one place.
period_description: Daily earnings and deductions for your selected period.
quick_body: The everyday essentials, one click away.
payroll_note_body: Salary history and recorded absences keep every calculation accurate.
name: Full name
salary_history_hint: Each rate applies from its effective date until the next change.
archive_hint: Set the last day of employment. The employee and payroll history will be kept.
unarchive_hint: Choose the return-to-work date. Salary resumes on scheduled working days from that date, using the salary history. The time away is excluded and previous records are preserved.
return_after_end: The return-to-work date must be after the previous employment end date.
employment_state_changed: This employment period is already closed or active. Refresh the employee and check their current status.
employment_periods_hint: Salary counts only within these periods. Time between periods is excluded.
calendar_employment_gap: This range includes time away from employment. Select dates within an employment period.
advance_body: Keep track of payments made ahead of payday.
absence_body: A clear record of time away, down to the half-day.
calendar_hint: Select the first and last red dates to prepare payroll. Choose a yellow day to open its unpaid statement. Green days are paid and cannot be selected.
calendar_week_note: A dot marks a non-working day. The colour shows the payroll status of that date.
calendar_choose_end: Select the last date, or preview this single day.
calendar_selection_hint: Use the calendar or enter dates below. You can select across months.
calendar_choose_dates: Select a start and end date.
calendar_invalid_dates: Enter a valid period with the end on or after the start.
calendar_future: Future dates cannot be included in a payroll statement.
calendar_paid_range: This range contains paid days. Select a range without green days.
calendar_finalized_range: This range crosses a finalized period. Select only red dates, or choose a yellow day to open its complete statement.
calendar_existing_hint: This period already has an unpaid statement. Open it to record payment.
calendar_no_paid_days: New statements can include only unfinalized dates. Paid days cannot be selected.
calendar_report_hint: Print a summary for any period, including previous payments. To prepare or pay a statement, use Select unpaid days.
statement_body: Prepare, finalize, and keep a clear record of every payment.
finalize_body: The amounts will be saved, and payroll entries in this period will be locked. Finalized statements cannot be edited or deleted.
payment_confirmation: Confirm that the remaining amount has been paid in full.
formula_hint: Base salary − unpaid absence deductions − advances − paid payroll statements = remaining pay
negative_balance: Advances exceed earnings for this period. The negative balance is retained in this statement.
pdf_hint: Choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog to download a PDF in the selected language.
settings_body: Make this workspace work for you.
working_days_hint: These days count toward daily pay. Finalized statements keep their original calendar.
backup_body: Download an encrypted backup of your workspace. Automatic daily backups run when the Docker scheduler is running.
backup_key_hint: Keep your APP_KEY securely: it is required to restore encrypted backups.
currency_hint: Choose your currency before adding employees. Existing amounts are never automatically converted.
account_body: Manage the password for your administrator account.
choose_period: Choose a period to calculate payroll.
not_found: This page could not be found.
invalid_login: These credentials do not match our records.
period_locked: This date belongs to a finalized payroll period and cannot be changed.
outside_employment: The date must be within the employee’s employment dates.
missing_rate: A daily salary is missing for part of this period.
employment_locked: Employment dates are protected after archiving, reactivation, or finalizing payroll. Use Archive employee or Reactivate employee to record departures and returns.
existing_records_outside: Existing advances or absences fall outside these employment dates.
rate_conflict: This start date conflicts with the salary history.
archive_date: The end date must be on or after the start date and all recorded entries and finalized periods.
archive_instead: This employee has payroll history. Archive the employee to keep those records.
period_too_long: Choose a period of at most 366 days.
non_working_day: Absences can only be recorded on scheduled working days.
initial_rate_required: Keep the initial salary rate on the employee’s start date.
overlapping_statement: This period overlaps an existing finalized statement. Choose an unpaid, unfinalized period.
already_paid: This statement is already marked as paid.
invalid_payment: Payment must be on or after the period end, and the balance must not be negative.
currency_locked: Currency cannot change after employees are added, to preserve the meaning of recorded amounts.
session_expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
